title: Lifting a valuation ring through a flat scheme morphism
statement: Let $f:Y\to T$ be a flat morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-flat-morphism]. Let $R$ be a valuation ring [def-trf-valuation-ring] and let $b:\operatorname{Spec}R\to T$ be a morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Assume that the image under $b$ of the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}R$ belongs to $f(Y)$. Then there exist a valuation ring $R\prime$, an injective local homomorphism $\iota:R\to R\prime$ (local means $\iota^{-1}(\mathfrak m_{R\prime})=\mathfrak m_R$), and a morphism $c:\operatorname{Spec}R\prime\to Y$ such that $f\circ c=b\circ\operatorname{Spec}(\iota)$. No finite-presentation, Noetherian, rank, or discreteness hypothesis is imposed.
